subject: Montara pilot: short executive intro + demo window
messages:
From: Jason Lowe <jason@montara.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — can your VP or CIO join 30m demo this week?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We’re excited to kick the pilot planning into motion. The leadership team at Montara — specifically Leah Park (CIO) — wants a short executive intro before the technical demo. Can your VP/CIO-level sponsor join a 25–30 minute slot on Wednesday or Thursday this week? We understand exec calendars are tight; Leah is flexible on time but would prefer an afternoon PST window.

Agenda: 5m intros, 15m tailored demo (focus on inference economics), 5–10m outcomes & next steps. I attached a one-page agenda and our security checklist so you can route anything to your security team if needed.

Short answers are great — do you have high-level availability or someone to nominate as the exec sponsor?

Appreciate it,
Jason
Montara AI
attachments: montara-MVP-agenda.pdf, security-reqs.xlsx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lowe <jason@montara.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can your VP or CIO join 30m demo this week?

Hi Jason — thanks for the clear agenda and the attachments. I looked at Leah’s note and we’d be glad to set a short exec intro + demo. Two immediate constraints: our Head of Sales (Ben) is OOO Thursday morning but can cover the run; our VP of Product (Markus) has a late-afternoon block on Wednesday. To avoid dropping exec-level signal, I can offer the following options where a VP or my director will definitely join for the first 8–10 minutes and hand off to Ben for the deep demo:

- Wed 17 Jul, 3:30–4:00 PM PST — VP-level participation confirmed for first 10 minutes (quick intro, business alignment)
- Thu 18 Jul, 4:00–4:30 PM PST — Senior director will join; Ben will lead demo from minute 6 onward

If neither is acceptable, I can escalate to request a 30-minute slot next Monday where the VP can guarantee full attendance.

Quick ask: which option does Leah prefer? Also, any special security items from the attached sheet we should pre-escalate to our infosec?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Lowe <jason@montara.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can your VP or CIO join 30m demo this week?

Gotta run to a demo prep standup but: happy to lead the technical 15m and will be available for both windows. If Hannah needs me to cover the VP intro for the Wed slot I’ll prep a 5-slide quick context piece focused on throughput/cost tradeoffs.

I will also prepare the short infosec bullets on the security checklist — Rachel can route any SOC2/Security artifacts we need to share.

—Ben

Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Jason Lowe <jason@montara.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@montara.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 08:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can your VP or CIO join 30m demo this week?

All — thanks for the rapid options. Leah confirms Wed 17 Jul 3:30–4:00 PM PST works best. She prefers the VP for the first 10m introduction and then Ben to lead the demo. Can we lock that and send a calendar invite? Also, two small asks before the call:

1) Can you attach the SOC2 summary page and a short note about data retention limits (we’ll share with procurement)?
2) If possible, add a one-line expected outcome to the invite (e.g., "Confirm pilot scope & next steps — decision checkpoint by EOW").

If that’s nailed, I’ll get Leah’s calendar hold in place and we’ll send invites on our side.

—Jason
Project Lead, Montara AI
